name: Directional Blur
description: Recreation of the CapCut "Blur" animation. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

params.name: progress
params.description: 0 = start of the in animation, 1 = the untouched clip. Use 1 - progress for an out animation

params.name: angle
params.description: Direction of the blur in degrees, 0 = horizontal, clockwise

params.name: strength
params.description: Blur length at progress 0, in parts of the longer side
